rationale: The bid-ask spread of 114.9 bps creates an immediate structural disadvantage that makes any intraday trade extremely difficult to profit from, as price must move well beyond the spread just to break even. The stock has already made an enormous intraday range (from $12.52 to $16.96) and is now sitting at 90.3% of that range with only 68 minutes to close, suggesting most of the directional move is exhausted. With volume tapering sharply on the last few candles and no clear momentum signal in either direction, the risk/reward does not justify entry.
